我一共來了三次，但是發現整體越來越退步。
1.桌面沒擦拭乾淨，有湯漬。
2.桌面上一直有小黑蠅在飛，用餐中看著這些蟲心裡其實很不爽😠
3.他們21:30打烊，20:30就會準備打烊前置作業了，會一桌一桌請客人起身去櫃檯結帳，像我們20:00才剛用餐想說怎麼又要起身⋯⋯挺麻煩的。
4.招待卡（集點卡），這個東西用餐如果沒帶到，代表此次的消費無法累積，有一次我就忘記帶出門了，那次少了4鍋的消費累積，說真的～這張卡不是很便捷，大家都用line累積來店次數了,不要增加客人的麻煩，謝謝。
5. 菜盤的青江菜到了2-3次發現葉子皺皺的趨勢
6.不建議老人家來享用，因為入內是走樓梯。

We came here as our hotel was nearby and we spotted the impressive 4.9 Google rating, so it was an easy choice for dinner. The restaurant was almost full when we arrived, but we were fortunate not to have to wait for a table.

The service staff was really friendly and welcoming from the start. Our waiter noticed we were tourists and took the time to explain the menu to us, patiently encouraging us to look through and ask if we needed anything clarified. Throughout the meal, the waiters also checked in on us a couple of times to make sure everything was to our liking — that kind of attentiveness really made a difference.

What was unique was that the hotpot was individual rather than the usual shared pot that a table orders together. This was actually great as each person could order exactly what they wanted. The meat and vegetables were fresh and tasted great. Some of the seafood and hotpot items were frozen, and while they were still decent, some items tasted just ordinary. The prawns however were fresh and sweet.

The ambience was casual and comfortable, and it was not too noisy the evening we visited. The pricing was also very reasonable — noticeably lower than most hotpot places we had been to, making it good value for money.

That said, I wanted to leave an honest rating. While the service was excellent, the food was decent but not the best tasting. It is not a perfect 5 stars for me, but it was still a good restaurant and worth a visit if you are in the area.
